issue: `export-claims` no longer emits the source values untouched: it coerces `claim_id`, `statement`, `assent` and `lifecycle` with `str()` and drops claims whose id or statement is blank, where the source exported any claim that had both keys. A YAML integer id `1` now exports as "1". The PRD says to preserve the export contract, so this is a small drift in the data shape.

Null values bypass required validation: `assent: null`, `lifecycle: null`, `doubts: null`, and a doubt with `mode: null` evade their enum/list rules. Distinguish absent keys from present null values and test both cases.

Non-string source values disappear through `sources()` before validation, so malformed values can pass without `source-shape`. Validate the raw source value and each list entry before extracting strings.

`iter_note_files` checks resolved paths but returns unresolved aliases, contrary to the graph contract. An internal symlink duplicates exported claims and counts and can produce a false filename mismatch; graph keys also differ from resolved edges. Return sorted, deduplicated resolved paths and test internal aliases.

Prune and corroboration checks compare literal link paths. A valid inbound link containing `./` or an internal symlink is missed, incorrectly reporting a linked note as a prune candidate. Resolve targets consistently with the validator before comparing note identities.

Export destination expansion, resolution and `samefile` checks execute outside error handling. A symlink loop or inaccessible ancestor can raise instead of returning a failed `CommandResult`. Include destination preparation in the guarded operation and test failures before writing.
The staleness test changed: the source used `age > timedelta(days=window)`, the port uses `(now - last).days > window_days`, so a run 7d 5h ago counts as fresh now and stale in the source.

The status metadata drops the source `sources` and `pending_sources` keys, and the first output lines changed from vault/zettels/sources to tiromex/notes; the PRD defers mirror pending counts to 00153 but also says to port the output keys.

A new note ends at the H1 with no final `---` backmatter separator; the bim formatter omits it when there is no backmatter and the format spec documents this. PRD wording "final backmatter separator" is ambiguous; judged acceptable.
`CommandTxNew` validates a draft from `prepare()`, then `execute()` builds the note again; id and date can differ by a second or after a collision bump. Risk judged negligible.

Prune-candidate detection in `status` is O(n²) over notes because each concept note re-parses every other note's relations; no PRD performance requirement, but a large tiromex folder makes `status` slow.
`claims: []` on a non-claim-bearing, non-aporia concept note now fails with `claims-count`; the source allowed it. Deliberate drift per "1-3 claims when present".

Recursive cycle traversal can raise `RecursionError` on a sufficiently deep relation chain. This is explicitly recorded and the design mandates porting the source DFS unchanged; changing its traversal strategy exceeds that parity requirement.
